display.purpose: Session score reveal and scenario result totals. One instance per screen maximum.

headline.purpose: Section headings and results summary headers.

title.purpose: Card titles, button labels, verdict button labels.

body.purpose: Scenario setting text, answer option text. Line length naturally limited by mobile viewport.

label.purpose: Table headers, section labels, disclosure row headers, pill text.

caption.purpose: Supporting metadata, timestamps, unofficial disclaimer text.

mono.purpose: Clinical numerals and vital values only. Monospace for tabular scanning alignment.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Patient card only. Communicates swipe affordance. Diffuse, not decorative. React Native: shadowOpacity 0.08, shadowRadius 16, offset 0/6, elevation 4.

shadows.name: segment-lift
shadows.purpose: Active segment of segmented control. Communicates selection state as a subtle float-above-track cue. React Native: shadowOpacity 0.06, shadowRadius 6, offset 0/2, elevation 2.

motion.name: swipe-commit
motion.purpose: Patient card swipe commits. Card follows finger; release snaps to committed position or springs back.

motion.name: press-feedback
motion.purpose: Button press state. Fast enough to feel tactile; slow enough to register.

motion.name: verdict-press
motion.purpose: Verdict button press. Slightly more pronounced than regular button for the high-stakes action.

motion.name: disclosure-expand
motion.purpose: Disclosure row open/close animation. Smooth layout transition, no bounce.

motion.name: image-transition
motion.purpose: Scenario image load-in. expo-image transition prop.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action. Deep Pine fill, Moonlit Bone text, 12px radius, 52px height.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Non-primary action on same surface. White fill with 1px Warm Stone border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1A1E1B; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #CFCCC0; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.1s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F6F5F1; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.85; transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0B5E3B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Verdict: Not Sick
components.description: Left verdict button. Pine Mist fill, 2px Deep Pine border. Calm, affirming. Fixed bottom, min 64px.
components.html: <button class="ds-verdict-not-sick"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0B5E3B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6"/></svg>Not sick</button>
components.css: .ds-verdict-not-sick { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 64px; flex: 1; padding: 0 16px; background: #E6F0EA; color: #0B5E3B; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; border: 2px solid #0B5E3B; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.1s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-verdict-not-sick:active { opacity: 0.88; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-verdict-not-sick:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0B5E3B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Verdict: Sick
components.description: Right verdict button. Terracotta Alarm fill, Pale Ash text. Urgent, decisive. Fixed bottom, min 64px.
components.html: <button class="ds-verdict-sick">Sick<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#FBF1EF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-verdict-sick { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 64px; flex: 1; padding: 0 16px; background: #B23A2E; color: #FBF1EF; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.1s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-verdict-sick:active { opacity: 0.88; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-verdict-sick:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #B23A2E; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: MCQ Option (Idle)
components.description: Answer row in idle state. Lettered badge, answer text. Transforms on reveal.
components.css: .ds-mcq-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 60px; padding: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1A1E1B; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; border: 1px solid #E2E0D8; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: opacity 0.1s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-mcq-option:hover { background: #FCFBF8; } .ds-mcq-option:active { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(0.995); } .ds-mcq-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0B5E3B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mcq-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; min-width: 28px; background: #F6F5F1; color: #5A615B; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-mcq-text { flex: 1; line-height: 21px; }

components.name: MCQ Option (Correct)
components.description: Correct-answer reveal state. Pine Mist background, Deep Pine border, checkmark badge.

components.name: MCQ Option (Wrong)
components.description: Wrong-answer reveal state. Terracotta Wash background, Terracotta border, X badge.

components.name: Pill: Brand
components.description: Clinical level or skill category badge. Pine Mist background, Pine Dark text, pill radius.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill-brand { background: #E6F0EA; color: #084A2E; }

components.name: Pill: Neutral
components.description: Secondary metadata badge. Dry Grass background, Aged Moss text.

components.name: Pill: Warn
components.description: Status note or informational flag. Amber Parchment background, Amber Brown text.

components.name: Disclosure Row
components.description: Expandable clinical detail section. Cream Parchment background, hairline border, chevron toggle.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { background: #FCFBF8; border: 1px solid #E2E0D8; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-disclosure-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure-header:hover { background: #F6F5F1; } .ds-disclosure-header:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0B5E3B; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-disclosure-title { font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; color: #1A1E1B; }

components.name: Unofficial Banner
components.description: Non-dismissable informational disclaimer. Amber Parchment background, info icon, caption text. Present wherever clinical content is visible.
components.html: Independent practice tool. Not an official St John Ambulance product.
components.css: .ds-unofficial-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #FBF1DE; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-unofficial-text { font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: #8A6312; flex: 1; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Binary/ternary toggle. Dry Grass track, Clean Sheet active segment with lift shadow. Used for CFA/ER level selection.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: #E2E0D8; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-segment { flex: 1; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; background: transparent; color: #5A615B; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-segment:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); } .ds-segment-active { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1A1E1B; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(26, 30, 27, 0.06); } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0B5E3B; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a clinical training tool used under stress, outdoors, one-handed. The aesthetic reflects a well-thumbed field notebook: warm bone paper, ink that has settled into the page, purposeful structure with no decorative noise. Every design decision exists to accelerate a clinical decision, not to express brand personality.

The system explicitly rejects clinical white (sterile, generic hospital-app), emergency green (first-reflex SJA-official), and the neon-red or alarm-orange typical of emergency-services interfaces. Alarm color is earned through context. It appears only when the stakes demand it, always paired with an icon and text label so color is never the sole signal.

The experience is calibrated for sunlight legibility. An SJA volunteer at a crowded outdoor county show, glancing one-handed between patients, should be able to read a primary survey, make a verdict call, and move to the next scenario in under 30 seconds. Density is a virtue here.
keyCharacteristics: Light-only (sunlight legibility; no dark mode at launch)
Warm bone/cream surfaces, never clinical white or pure black
Semantic alarm color paired with icon and label (never color alone)
Touch targets 52px minimum (64px for the verdict decision)
Monospace numerals for clinical vitals; system sans for all other text
Tonal-layering depth model; patient card is the only true raised surface
No decorative shadows, glassmorphism, gradient text, or side-stripe borders
UnofficialBanner appears wherever clinical content is visible; not dismissable

rules.name: The Non-Color-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every instance of Terracotta or Deep Pine in a semantic context (sick/not-sick, correct/wrong) must be paired with a text label and an icon. Color is reinforcement, not signal.

rules.name: The Saffron Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Warm Saffron covers under 10% of any given screen. Its rarity is what makes it readable as 'note, not action.' Saffron on a button, input, or segmented control is a design error.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Clinical Rule
rules.body: Monospace type is for clinical numerals and vital values only. Using it for decoration, branding, or copywriting is prohibited.

rules.name: The Weight-Over-Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is established first through weight contrast (700/600/400), then confirmed by size. Never set two adjacent text elements at the same weight with different sizes to create hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface starts flat. A shadow must justify itself by naming the physical affordance it communicates (swipe, selection lift). New shadows without that justification are design errors.

rules.name: The Three-Level Rule
rules.body: The depth stack is: ground (Warm Bone), field (Cream Parchment), foreground (Clean Sheet). A surface outside this hierarchy is suspect. Nested cards at the same level violate this rule.

dos: Do use Deep Pine (#0B5E3B) for primary actions, active states, correct-answer reveals, and the 'not sick' verdict. It is the only green allowed.
Do pair every semantic color instance with a text label and an icon. Non-color cues are mandatory.
Do use monospace type exclusively for clinical numerals and vital values.
Do reserve Clean Sheet (#FFFFFF) for foregrounded interactive surfaces: the patient card and MCQ option rows.
Do keep verdict buttons at 64px min-height, fixed below the scroll view, always reachable without scrolling.
Do add haptic feedback to verdict commits (ImpactFeedbackStyle.Medium) and MCQ selections.
Do include the UnofficialBanner on every screen where clinical content is visible.
Do cap Warm Saffron (#E8B23A) at under 10% of any screen surface.
donts: Don't use clinical white, pure #000, or emergency green (#00C853-family) for surface or text.
Don't use red cross iconography, generic medical clip-art, or bright emergency-service color palettes.
Don't nest cards within the patient card. The patient card is the only true raised card.
Don't use color as the sole signal for sick/not-sick or correct/wrong.
Don't place Warm Saffron on buttons, inputs, segmented controls, or any interactive surface.
Don't add decorative shadows, glassmorphism, gradient overlays, gradient text, or side-stripe border accents.
Don't reference St John Ambulance's official brand identity: no SJA cross, no official logo, no 'SJA' wordmark.
Don't introduce dark-mode UI patterns. Light-only at launch.
Don't add bounce or elastic motion curves, decorative entrance animations, or scroll-driven choreography.
